title: M2: SliQ real-report load runbook and aged-debtors reconciliation
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/SLIQ-LOAD-RUNBOOK.md for the reported .xls/title/header-row6/totals layout, DD/MM/YYYY, gross20%VAT, 2035 invoices plus2 Crd=2037 baseline rows to13October and79 customers. These are attributed user facts, not inspected originals; final November counts/totals remain blank and require fresh full exports or reviewed delta covering14October to cut-off.

Explains true-format conversion/provenance (loader supports CSV/XLSX and first-nonblank header), kind/sign/VAT/credit de-duplication, actual shared quote-line support, empty PO-line limitation, report/transaction/control distinctions and rehearsal-only CLI guard. No invented production command or guard bypass; operational route must be separately reviewed.

Includes complete before/after ID/count/money controls, all unpaid invoices both ways, account/bucket/grand-total three-way aged-debtors tie-out, opening/unallocated credits/cash bridge and protected-company comparisons. John/accounts/Code/reviewer/Rhys sign separately. Missing original files, totals, loader, comparison or signer stops affected use. Source/calendar/arithmetic/control and whitespace checks pass; no actual load/runtime or reconciliation result claimed. No production SQL, main merge, Ready label, deployment or new importer feature.
